annotations.title: USD prices for up to 20 tokens in one call

description: USD prices for up to 20 ERC-20 tokens on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or Optimism in one call, each from its deepest Uniswap v3 pool against USDC or WETH, read live from the chain, with pool, reserve and a thin-liquidity flag. Tokens without a pool are listed under unpriced instead of failing the call. Spot prices, not time averages. Use to value a basket of tokens or refresh a watchlist in one paid call. Price $0.005/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
